products.name: Surfer SEO
products.note: SEO optimization AI; content scoring; NLP analysis; EU-hosted options

profile_text.body:
Surfer, found at surferseo.com, describes itself as an AI visibility platform aimed at marketing and SEO teams. Its stated focus is helping brands track and improve their presence across both traditional search on Google and AI-driven search engines including ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude. The company says it analyzes signals around structure, depth, and credibility rather than keyword density, and frames its offering as an "AI Search Operating System" designed to update itself as search algorithms change.

The core product, Surfer SEO, combines content scoring, NLP analysis, and AI-assisted writing and editing tools into a single workflow. Features the company highlights include competitive analysis, topical authority planning, programmatic page generation, real-time SEO guidelines within a writing interface, and always-on monitoring that alerts users when a page loses visibility or a competitor displaces them in an AI-generated answer. EU-hosted options are available. The company also offers supplementary tools such as a Chrome extension, an AI detector, and an AI humanizer. User testimonials on the site describe outcomes such as doubling blog content production while reducing per-piece cost by more than four times, though these figures come from individual customer accounts rather than independently verified data.

The site's held facts confirm Surfer SEO is categorized as a writing and editing product with an SEO optimization focus. No litigation, SEC filings, patents, or MCP server registrations are recorded in the available data.
